items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I don't know why Mr. Jones, Tenan Jones, named it

ctx.x: What was the difference between those two?

The Elite Number One was way downtown -- I mean, not way downtown. It was down around a hundred and -- it was further down on State Street than Elite Number Two. I don't know why they called it Elite Number Two. I don't know why Mr. Jones, Tenan Jones, named it --
